name: Tongyu Communication Inc.
summary: Tongyu Communication Inc. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of communication antennas and radio frequency devices worldwide. The company offers base station antennas, including 5G, multi-band, multi-beam, beamforming, smallcell, special application, and indoor antennas; microwave antennas and components; RF components comprising combiners, filters, IBS components, RF cables and connectors, and GPS; and satcom products, such as payload antennas, ground stations, and various terminals.
